items.name: A foundation model for generalizable disease detection from retinal images
items.description: Nature, 2023. [All Versions]. This paper presents RETFound, a foundation model for retinal images that learns generalizable representations from unlabelled retinal images and provides a basis for label-efficient model adaptation in several applications. Specifically, RETFound is trained on 1.6 million unlabelled retinal images by means of self-supervised learning and then adapted to disease detection tasks with explicit labels.
